create_unclip_image_interpolation_pipeli: create a UnCLIPImageInterpolationPipeline to generate image variations from two input images using spherical linear interpolation
run_slerp_interpolation: run spherical linear interpolation between two image embeddings to generate intermediate embeddings
encode_image_embeddings: encode input images into CLIP image embeddings for use in the unCLIP diffusion pipeline
generate_interpolated_images: generate interpolated image variations by decoding slerped embeddings through the decoder and super-resolution stages
prepare_latents_for_diffusion: prepare random or provided latents for the decoder and super-resolution diffusion denoising steps
